models.name: shopping_mall_tax_categories
models.description:
System-wide tax category definitions used for product pricing and order calculations.

Defines standardized tax categories applied across all products and orders. Each tax category represents a tax rate with associated jurisdiction and description.

Used by shopping_mall_products, shopping_mall_orders, and shopping_mall_order_items to determine applicable tax rates.

This table ensures consistent tax application across the system, referenced by tax_category_id in product and order tables.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Display name of the tax category (e.g., 'VAT', 'GST', 'Sales Tax').

plainFields.name: rate
plainFields.description: Tax rate as decimal percentage (e.g., 0.08 for 8%). Must be between 0 and 1.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the tax category's jurisdiction and application rules.

plainFields.name: country_code
plainFields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'US', 'JP', 'KR') where this tax category applies.

plainFields.name: region
plainFields.description: Specific region or state name where this tax category applies (e.g., 'California', 'Tokyo').

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this tax category is currently active and applicable for new orders.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this tax category was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this tax category was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_methods
models.description:
System-defined payment method types supported by the platform for transaction processing.

Defines the payment methods that customers can use to complete transactions. These are fixed system types, not user-specific payment details.

Used by shopping_mall_order_payments to determine permitted payment types and processing rules.

This table enables consistent payment handling across all orders, referenced by payment_method_id in order payment records.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Display name of the payment method (e.g., 'Credit Card', 'PayPal', 'Bank Transfer').

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: System code identifier for this payment method (e.g., 'CREDIT_CARD', 'PAYPAL', 'BANK_TRANSFER'). Used in API and integration logic.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of how this payment method works and any special requirements.

plainFields.name: is_enabled
plainFields.description: Whether this payment method is currently enabled for customer use.

plainFields.name: is_priority
plainFields.description: Whether this payment method is displayed as a priority option during checkout.

plainFields.name: processing_fee
plainFields.description: Fixed processing fee charged when using this payment method (in USD). Zero if no fee.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment method was added to the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment method was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipping_methods
models.description:
System-defined shipping options available to customers during checkout.

Defines the shipping methods that sellers can offer and customers can select during checkout.

Used by shopping_mall_order_shipping to determine available shipping options, costs, and delivery time estimates.

This table maintains standardized shipping configurations that can be referenced by multiple sellers, linked to shipping_method_id in order shipping records.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Display name of the shipping method (e.g., 'Standard Delivery', 'Express Shipping', 'Same-Day Pickup').

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: System code identifier for this shipping method (e.g., 'STANDARD', 'EXPRESS', 'PICKUP'). Used in logistics integrations.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the shipping method's capabilities, restrictions, and delivery window.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this shipping method is currently active and available to customers.

plainFields.name: base_cost
plainFields.description: Base shipping cost in USD for this method. May be overridden per seller or order.

plainFields.name: estimated_days_min
plainFields.description: Minimum number of business days for delivery using this method.

plainFields.name: estimated_days_max
plainFields.description: Maximum number of business days for delivery using this method.

plainFields.name: enabled_for_international
plainFields.description: Whether this shipping method can be used for international orders.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this shipping method was added to the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this shipping method was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_system_flags
models.description:
Global system configuration flags that enable or disable platform-wide features and behaviors.

Contains boolean flags that control platform functionality without requiring code deployment. Used to toggle features on/off per environment or business need.

Referenced by application services to determine system behavior, such as allowing new registrations, payment processing, etc.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique name of the system flag (e.g., 'ENABLE_NEW_REGISTRATIONS', 'ALLOW_PAYMENT_PROCESSING', 'MAINTENANCE_MODE').

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Current state of the flag. True means enabled, false means disabled.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Explanation of what this flag controls and its impact on system behavior.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this system flag was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this system flag was last updated.

plainFields.name: updated_by
plainFields.description: ID of the admin who last modified this flag, referencing shopping_mall_admins.id.

models.name: shopping_mall_categories
models.description:
Hierarchical product category structure that organizes all products in the marketplace.

Defines the complete category taxonomy used to classify products. Categories support nesting (parent-child relationships) to create deep hierarchies.

Used by shopping_mall_products, shopping_mall_product_categories to determine product categorization and navigation.

This table creates the authoritative category structure referenced throughout the system, linked by category_id in product category mappings.

foreignFields.name: parent_category_id
foreignFields.description: Parent category in the hierarchy. Referencing the same shopping_mall_categories.id for nested categories. Null for top-level categories.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Display name of the category (e.g., 'Electronics', 'Books > Fiction').

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: URL-friendly identifier for this category (e.g., 'electronics', 'books-fiction').

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the category and what products belong in it.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this category is currently active and visible to customers.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Order in which this category should be displayed in UI lists. Lower numbers appear first.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_tags
models.description:
System-defined product tags for enhanced product categorization and search filtering.

Defines a pool of standardized tags that can be applied to products to improve search and filtering capabilities.

Used by shopping_mall_product_tags_products to associate tags with products, enabling keyword-based discovery and faceted navigation.

This table creates a controlled vocabulary of tags that can be referenced across all products, linked by tag_id in the junction table.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Display name of the product tag (e.g., 'Organic', 'Wireless', 'Heavy-Duty').

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: URL-friendly identifier for this tag (e.g., 'organic', 'wireless', 'heavy-duty').

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of what this tag represents and what products it should be applied to.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this tag is currently active and available for selection.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Order in which this tag should be displayed in UI lists. Lower numbers appear first.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this tag was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this tag was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description:
Primary customer identity record for the shoppingMall platform.

Stores core authentication and identification information for customers who browse and purchase products. Each customer may have multiple active sessions across different devices.

Relates to shopping_mall_customer_sessions for session management and to shopping_mall_orders for order history.

Customers are created during registration and require email verification before full access. May be suspended by admin but cannot be deleted.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Customer's verified email address used for authentication and notifications. Must be unique across all actors.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: BCrypt-hashed password for authentication. Never stored in plain text. Required for login functionality.

plainFields.name: first_name
plainFields.description: Customer's first/legal name as provided during registration.

plainFields.name: last_name
plainFields.description: Customer's last/legal name as provided during registration.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current account status. Valid values: 'active', 'suspended', 'pending_verification'. Determines access to platform features.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created. Used for audit trails and onboarding analytics.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer profile was last modified. Updated on property changes or password reset.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete flag for account deactivation. When null, account is active; when set, account is disabled but retained for compliance.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description:
Session record for authenticated customer interactions with the shoppingMall platform.

Each session represents a single active login instance for a customer across a specific device and network connection. Sessions are ephemeral and managed by the authentication system.

Maintains connection context for customer interactions including IP address, href, and referrer. Used for security monitoring and session management.

Relates to shopping_mall_customers via customer_id foreign key.

Follows strict session table pattern: {actor_base}_sessions with mandatory fields and index structure.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced customer account for this session. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was initiated. Used for security monitoring and geolocation.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL of the application accessed during this session. Used for user journey analysis.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Source URL that led the user to the platform. Used for marketing attribution and traffic analysis.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was established. Used for session duration calculation and audit trails.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session will expire or was terminated. If null, session is still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description:
Primary seller identity record for businesses selling on the shoppingMall platform.

Stores core authentication and identification information for business sellers who list and manage products for sale. Each seller may have multiple active sessions across different devices.

Relates to shopping_mall_seller_sessions for session management and to shopping_mall_products for product listings.

Sellers are created during registration and require document verification before active status. May be suspended by admin but cannot be deleted.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Seller's verified business email address used for authentication and notifications. Must be unique across all actors.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: BCrypt-hashed password for authentication. Never stored in plain text. Required for login functionality.

plainFields.name: business_name
plainFields.description: Legal business name as registered with government authorities. Displayed to customers on product listings.

plainFields.name: business_address
plainFields.description: Physical business address for tax and regulatory purposes. Not displayed to customers.

plainFields.name: tax_id
plainFields.description: Official tax identification number issued by government authority. Used for financial compliance.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current account status. Valid values: 'active', 'suspended', 'pending_verification', 'rejected'. Determines ability to list products and receive payments.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was created. Used for audit trails and onboarding analytics.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller profile or business information was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete flag for account deactivation. When null, account is active; when set, account is disabled but retained for compliance.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description:
Session record for authenticated seller interactions with the shoppingMall platform.

Each session represents a single active login instance for a seller across a specific device and network connection. Sessions are ephemeral and managed by the authentication system.

Maintains connection context for seller interactions including IP address, href, and referrer. Used for security monitoring and session management.

Relates to shopping_mall_sellers via seller_id foreign key.

Follows strict session table pattern: {actor_base}_sessions with mandatory fields and index structure.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced seller account for this session. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was initiated. Used for security monitoring and geolocation.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL of the application accessed during this session. Used for user journey analysis.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Source URL that led the user to the platform. Used for marketing attribution and traffic analysis.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was established. Used for session duration calculation and audit trails.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session will expire or was terminated. If null, session is still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_admins
models.description:
Primary admin identity record for platform administrators managing the shoppingMall platform.

Stores core authentication and identification information for platform operators with elevated privileges to manage users, content, and system settings.

Admins manage customer and seller accounts, moderate reviews, approve/reject products, access financial reports, and perform system-level actions.

Relates to shopping_mall_admin_sessions for session management.

Admins are manually created through internal processes. Cannot register via public interface. Always requires MFA and strict access controls.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Admin's verified email address used for authentication and notifications. Must be unique across all actors.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: BCrypt-hashed password for authentication. Never stored in plain text. Required for login functionality.

plainFields.name: first_name
plainFields.description: Admin's first/legal name as provided during onboarding.

plainFields.name: last_name
plainFields.description: Admin's last/legal name as provided during onboarding.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current account status. Valid values: 'active', 'suspended', 'pending_verification'. Determines access to admin interfaces.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created. Used for audit trails and access control history.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin profile was last modified. Updated on property changes or password reset.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete flag for account deactivation. When null, account is active; when set, account is disabled but retained for compliance.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_sessions
models.description:
Session record for authenticated admin interactions with the shoppingMall platform.

Each session represents a single active login instance for an admin across a specific device and network connection. Sessions are ephemeral and managed by the authentication system.

Maintains connection context for admin interactions including IP address, href, and referrer. Used for security monitoring and audit trails.

Relates to shopping_mall_admins via admin_id foreign key.

Follows strict session table pattern: {actor_base}_sessions with mandatory fields and index structure.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced admin account for this session. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was initiated. Used for security monitoring and geolocation.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL of the application accessed during this session. Used for user journey analysis.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Source URL that led the user to the platform. Used for marketing attribution and traffic analysis.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was established. Used for session duration calculation and audit trails.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session will expire or was terminated. If null, session is still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description:
Main product catalog entries representing distinct product offerings.

Each product represents a unique item available for sale with its defining attributes like title, description, price, and category. Products are created and managed by sellers and serve as the parent entity for product variants (SKUs). Products can be published or archived based on seller status and compliance.

When a product is published, it becomes visible to customers for browsing and purchasing. Archived products remain in the system for historical tracking and audit purposes but are not visible to customers. Products are linked to categories and tags for improved discoverability and search.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Owner seller. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_tax_category_id
foreignFields.description: Tax classification category. {@link shopping_mall_tax_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Product title displayed to customers. Must be 3-100 characters.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed product description visible to customers. Minimum 20 characters, maximum 2000 characters.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Base price of the product in USD. Minimum $0.01, maximum $5000.00.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Product availability status. Valid values: 'draft', 'published', 'archived'. Determines visibility to customers.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was created. Always recorded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last product update. Always updated on any modification.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was marked for deletion. Indicates soft delete status. Null means product is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variants
models.description:
Product variants (SKUs) that represent distinct inventory items with unique pricing and stock levels.

Each variant represents a specific configuration of a main product with different attributes such as color, size, or style. Variants are independent entities with their own pricing and inventory management, allowing for precise stock control and personalized pricing.

Variants are always linked to a single parent product and cannot exist without one. They enable the platform to handle complex products with multiple options while maintaining accurate inventory and pricing data for each configuration.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Parent product this variant belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: sku
plainFields.description: Unique Stock Keeping Unit identifier for this variant. Must be globally unique across all products and variants.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Variant-specific title that describes the configuration (e.g., 'Red, Size M').

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Specific price for this variant. Can differ from parent product base price.

plainFields.name: inventory_count
plainFields.description: Current available stock quantity for this variant. Must be 0 or greater.

plainFields.name: attributes
plainFields.description: JSON-formatted string containing variant attributes (e.g., {"color": "red", "size": "M"}). Used for filtering and display.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the variant was created. Always recorded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last variant update. Always updated on any modification.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the variant was marked for deletion. Indicates soft delete status. Null means variant is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_images
models.description:
Product image files associated with products and variants.

Stores image metadata and file references for all visual content associated with products. Each product may have multiple images, and each image is linked to either a product or variant. Images are managed through their parent entity and only exist in relation to a product.

Image files are referenced by URL or path, but actual file storage is handled externally. This model ensures each image is properly attributed and can be retrieved efficiently for display in product listings and detail pages.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Parent product this image belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Parent variant this image belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: Public URL path to the image file. Must be a valid URI format.

plainFields.name: alt_text
plainFields.description: Alternative text description for accessibility and SEO purposes.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description: Display order priority for viewing. Lower numbers display first. Must be 0 or greater.

plainFields.name: is_primary
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if this is the primary image for the product or variant. Only one per product/variant can be primary.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image was added to the product or variant.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the image record. Always updated on any modification.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image record was marked for deletion. Indicates soft delete status. Null means image is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_tags_products
models.description:
Junction table for many-to-many relationship between products and tags.

Enables flexible tagging system where products can have multiple tags and tags can be applied to multiple products. This table creates the link between product catalog entries and their textual tags for improved search, filtering, and categorization.

Tags are defined in the shopping_mall_product_tags table and represent keywords or categories that help customers discover products. This junction table allows for dynamic tagging without requiring schema changes and supports complex queries on product attributes.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product associated with this tag. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_tag_id
foreignFields.description: Tag applied to this product. {@link shopping_mall_product_tags.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the tag was applied to the product.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_categories
models.description:
Junction table linking products to categories through a many-to-many relationship.

Enables products to belong to multiple categories (e.g., a product can be both 'Electronics' and 'Gifts'). Category hierarchy is managed in shopping_mall_categories table, and this junction table defines the association between products and their categories.

This approach allows flexible product categorization without duplicating data and enables comprehensive category-based navigation and filtering in the product catalog.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product associated with this category. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Category this product belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was assigned to this category.

models.name: shopping_mall_carts
models.description:
Active shopping carts for customers, representing items selected for immediate purchase.

Each cart represents a customer's active selection of products to purchase, containing cart items that are held for a limited period before expiring. Carts are temporary working areas for customer shopping sessions and are distinct from wishlists which represent long-term interest items.

Carts are linked to customers via customer_id and have an expiration date after which they are automatically cleared. Carts are never shared between customers and represent individual shopping sessions.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this cart. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current state of the cart. Valid values: active, expired, checked_out. Indicates whether the cart is ready for checkout, has expired, or been converted to an order.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when this cart will expire and its items will be automatically removed. Standard expiration is 24 hours from creation for logged-in users, 7 days for anonymous users.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart was created. Required for auditing cart lifecycle.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart was last modified. Updated whenever items are added, removed, or quantities changed.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp indicating when this cart was removed. Used for audit trails and potential recovery of abandoned carts (before permanent purge).

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_items
models.description:
Individual items within a shopping cart, capturing product selections at time of addition.

Cart items represent specific product variants selected by the customer for purchase, with prices captured at the time of addition to ensure consistency during checkout even if product prices change later. Each cart item belongs exclusively to one cart and is removed upon checkout or cart expiration.

This table stores the state of products at cart creation time to provide price stability and prevent pricing disputes between customer and seller. Cart items are ephemeral and only exist while the parent cart is active.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Cart to which this item belongs. {@link shopping_mall_carts.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: The specific product variant being added to cart. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units of this product variant in the cart. Must be at least 1 and cannot exceed available inventory at time of addition.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Unit price of the product variant at the exact moment it was added to the cart. This ensures price stability during checkout even if product price changes later.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current state of this cart item. Valid values: active, out_of_stock, removed, checked_out. Active items are available for checkout, out_of_stock items are marked when inventory changes, removed items were manually deleted, and checked_out items were purchased in order.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart item was added to the cart. Required for auditing cart modifications and understanding purchase decisions.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart item was last modified. Updated when quantity changes or status changes (e.g., from active to out_of_stock).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp indicating when this cart item was removed. Used for audit trails and understanding cart abandonment patterns.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlists
models.description:
User-created lists of products for potential future purchase, persisting across sessions.

Wishlists represent products that customers are interested in but are not immediately purchasing. Unlike carts which are temporary working areas for checkout, wishlists are persistent collections of items customers want to consider later. Customers can maintain multiple wishlists with custom names and organize products for future consideration.

Wishlists have no expiration and remain active until explicitly deleted by the customer. They are independent of cart functionality and serve as long-term interest tracking tools rather than purchasing tools.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this wishlist. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: User-defined name for this wishlist. Examples: 'Future Gifts', 'Travel Essentials', 'Home Improvement'. Maximum 100 characters.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this wishlist was created. Required for audit trails and understanding customer interest patterns over time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this wishlist was last modified. Updated when items are added, removed, or when name is changed.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp indicating when this wishlist was removed. Used for audit trails and potential recovery.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_items
models.description:
Individual items within a wishlist, representing products of potential future interest.

Wishlist items capture products that customers have expressed interest in for possible future purchase. Unlike cart items, wishlist items do not capture pricing at time of addition since prices may change over time and these are not immediate purchases.

These items persist indefinitely until removed by the customer and serve as long-term interest tracking rather than transactional records. Wishlist items are organized within their parent wishlist and can be reordered or annotated by the customer.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_id
foreignFields.description: Wishlist to which this item belongs. {@link shopping_mall_wishlists.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: The specific product variant being saved to wishlist. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this item was added to the wishlist. Required for understanding customer interest patterns and sequence of interest.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this wishlist item was last modified. Updated when note is added or priority changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp indicating when this wishlist item was removed. Used for audit trails and understanding interest decay.

plainFields.name: note
plainFields.description: Optional user-provided note about this wishlist item. Examples: 'For birthday gift next month', 'Waiting for sale', 'Compare with other brands'. Maximum 500 characters.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description:
Main order entity representing a customer's purchase transaction.

Captures the core details of each order placed through the shoppingMall platform. Each order is linked to a specific customer and contains product information, pricing, and overall order state. Orders can be modified during the checkout process but become immutable once payment is completed.

Orders form the central hub of the commerce workflow, connecting customers, products, payments, shipping, and returns. The order status progresses through defined lifecycle stages from creation to completion or cancellation.

All order entities (items, payments, shipping, returns) reference this parent order entity. Soft deletion supports order recovery before final cancellation.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who placed this order. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Primary seller responsible for fulfilling this order. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_method_id
foreignFields.description: Payment method used for this order. {@link shopping_mall_payment_methods.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_shipping_method_id
foreignFields.description: Shipping method selected for this order. {@link shopping_mall_shipping_methods.id}.

plainFields.name: order_number
plainFields.description: Unique order identifier in format ORD-YYYYMMDD-NNNNN. Must be globally unique.

plainFields.name: subtotal
plainFields.description: Total price of all items before taxes and shipping. Excludes discounts.

plainFields.name: tax_amount
plainFields.description: Total tax amount applied based on product categories and jurisdiction.

plainFields.name: shipping_fee
plainFields.description: Total shipping cost based on selected shipping method and destination.

plainFields.name: discount_amount
plainFields.description: Total discount applied from coupons or promotions.

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Final amount due after applying taxes, shipping, and discounts. subtotal + tax_amount + shipping_fee - discount_amount.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Currency code for this order (e.g., USD, KRW, EUR). Must match ISO 4217 standards.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current order status. Valid values: draft, pending_payment, paid, confirmed, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded, completed.

plainFields.name: business_status
plainFields.description: Additional business workflow status. Valid values: normal, fraud_review, refund_requested, return_requested, disputed, completed.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Additional notes from customer during checkout. Limited to 500 characters.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order was created. Always set during order draft creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order was last modified. Updated on status changes, shipping address updates, etc.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order was soft-deleted. NULL if active. Used for order recovery and audit trails.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_items
models.description:
Individual product items within an order.

Represents the specific products, quantities, and pricing details of each item in an order. Each order item references a specific product variant and captures its price at the exact moment of purchase,
ensuring accurate historical records even if prices change later.

Order items are always created as part of order creation and are managed exclusively through their parent order. They have no independent existence outside of an order context.

The line item price reflects the exact price paid by the customer at purchase time, which may differ from the current product price due to promotions or price changes.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Parent order containing this item. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Specific product variant being ordered. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units of this item in the order. Must be greater than zero.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Price per unit at the time of purchase. This may differ from current product price due to promotions or changes.

plainFields.name: item_total
plainFields.description: Total cost for this line item (quantity × unit_price). Calculated field preserved for auditing.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Special instructions from customer for this item (e.g., 'gift wrap', 'do not open until Christmas'). Limited to 250 characters.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_payments
models.description:
Payment details for an order.

Captures all payment information for a specific order, including the payment method, amount, transaction ID, and processing status. Each order has exactly one payment record (1:1 relationship).

Payment records are created when the order enters 'pending_payment' status and are updated throughout the payment lifecycle. This entity enables detailed financial tracking and reconciliation.

The payment record is linked directly to the order and references the payment method used. Payment status progresses from pending -> processing -> authorized -> captured -> failed -> refunded.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order this payment belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_method_id
foreignFields.description: Payment method used for this transaction. {@link shopping_mall_payment_methods.id}.

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Amount paid in the order's currency. Must match order.total_amount.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Currency code for this payment. Must match the order's currency.

plainFields.name: payment_status
plainFields.description: Current payment status. Valid values: pending, processing, authorized, captured, failed, refunded, chargeback.

plainFields.name: transaction_id
plainFields.description: Unique identifier from the payment gateway (e.g., Stripe transaction ID). Used for reconciliation.

plainFields.name: gateway_response
plainFields.description: Raw response from the payment gateway. Used for debugging and fraud analysis.

plainFields.name: processed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when payment processing completed. NULL if still pending.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when payment record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when payment record was last updated (e.g., when status changed).

models.name: shopping_mall_order_shipping
models.description:
Shipping details for an order.

Stores the complete shipping information for an order, including destination address, shipping method, carrier details, and tracking information.

Each order has exactly one shipping record (1:1 relationship). This entity captures the shipping state at the time of order processing, allowing accurate historical retrieval even if customer addresses change later.

Shipping records are created when the order enters 'pending_payment' status. Tracking numbers are populated when the seller marks the order as shipped.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order this shipping information belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_shipping_method_id
foreignFields.description: Shipping method selected for this order. {@link shopping_mall_shipping_methods.id}.

plainFields.name: first_name
plainFields.description: Recipient's first name for delivery. Required for shipping.

plainFields.name: last_name
plainFields.description: Recipient's last name for delivery. Required for shipping.

plainFields.name: address_line1
plainFields.description: Primary street address line for delivery.

plainFields.name: address_line2
plainFields.description: Secondary address line (apartment, suite, etc.). Optional.

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: City for delivery address.

plainFields.name: state
plainFields.description: State, province, or region for delivery address.

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal or ZIP code for delivery address.

plainFields.name: country
plainFields.description: Country code for delivery address (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard).

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Contact phone number for delivery carrier.

plainFields.name: carrier
plainFields.description: Carrier company name (e.g., FedEx, UPS, Korea Post).

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Tracking number provided by carrier. Populated when order is marked as shipped.

plainFields.name: tracking_url
plainFields.description: URL to track this shipment on the carrier's website.

plainFields.name: estimated_delivery_date
plainFields.description: Estimated delivery date based on shipping method and destination.

plainFields.name: real_delivery_date
plainFields.description: Actual delivery date when confirmed by carrier system.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when shipping record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when shipping record was last updated (e.g., when tracking number was added).

models.name: shopping_mall_order_returns
models.description:
Return requests and processing details for orders.

Manages the return lifecycle for products purchased through orders. Each return is associated with a specific order and tracks return status, reason, and processing details.

Return records are created when a customer requests a return. They capture the original order, products being returned, reason for return, and processing status.

Returns follow a controlled workflow: requested -> approved -> received -> refunded -> completed. This entity enables proper refund processing and inventory reconciliation.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Original order for which return is requested. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: return_reason
plainFields.description: Primary reason for return. Valid values: wrong_item, damaged_item, defective_item, too_expensive, changed_mind, no_longer_needed, other.

plainFields.name: return_details
plainFields.description: Additional details explaining the return reason. Limited to 500 characters.

plainFields.name: return_status
plainFields.description: Current return status. Valid values: requested, approved, awaiting_return, received, refunded, completed, denied.

plainFields.name: refund_amount
plainFields.description: Amount refunded to customer for this return. May be partial refund based on product condition.

plainFields.name: return_method
plainFields.description: Return method type. Valid values: mail_return, in_store_return, pickup_return.

plainFields.name: return_tracking_number
plainFields.description: Return shipping tracking number provided to customer. Populated when return is approved.

plainFields.name: return_tracking_url
plainFields.description: URL to track return shipment on carrier's website.

plainFields.name: approved_by_admin_id
plainFields.description: Admin who approved this return request. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: approved_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when return was approved by admin.

plainFields.name: received_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when returned item was received at warehouse.

plainFields.name: refund_processed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when refund was processed to customer.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when return request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when return record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_status_history
models.description:
Historical record of order status changes.

This snapshot table captures point-in-time state changes for orders, preserving the complete audit trail of how an order progressed through its lifecycle.

Each record logs a specific status change event with timestamp, user who made the change, and any associated notes. This enables forensic analysis of order processing, dispute resolution, and compliance reporting.

This table follows the snapshot pattern, is append-only, and should never be directly updated or deleted. The data here is used for business intelligence and audit compliance.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order this status change belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who initiated the status change (if applicable). {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who initiated the change (if applicable). {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: previous_status
plainFields.description: Status value before the change. Valid values: draft, pending_payment, paid, confirmed, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded, completed.

plainFields.name: new_status
plainFields.description: Status value after the change. Valid values: draft, pending_payment, paid, confirmed, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded, completed.

plainFields.name: status_change_reason
plainFields.description: Reason for status change. Could be system action, customer request, or admin intervention.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Additional context about the status change. Limited to 500 characters.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of exactly when the status change occurred. Always set at creation.

plainFields.name: created_by
plainFields.description: Indicates who initiated this status change: 'admin' or 'customer'. Required for audit compliance.

models.name: shopping_mall_reviews
models.description:
Customer and seller reviews for products on the shoppingMall platform.

Stores user-generated feedback about products, including ratings, written comments, and metadata about the review creation context. Each review is associated with a specific product and created by either a customer or seller. Reviews require moderation before becoming publicly visible and support independent search, filtering, and management workflows.

Reviews have their own lifecycle independent of products - they can be created, edited, reported, moderated, and deleted without affecting the product listing itself. This separation allows for specialized review moderation systems without polluting the product catalog service.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: The product being reviewed. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who created this review. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: The admin who last moderated this review. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: The title or subject line of the review, if provided by the user. Limited to 100 characters.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: The main content of the review. Must be at least 10 characters long and contains the user's detailed feedback about the product.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: The numeric rating given by the user, from 1 to 5 stars. This is the core quantitative metric for product evaluation.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: The moderation status of the review. Valid values: 'pending', 'published', 'rejected', 'hidden'. Indicates whether the review is visible to customers.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the review was originally created by the user.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the review was last modified (e.g., edited by user or moderated by admin).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the review was soft-deleted. If null, the review is considered active. Used for audit trails and potential recovery.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_images
models.description:
Images uploaded by users to accompany their product reviews.

Stores image files that customers submit to support their written reviews with visual evidence of product quality, usage, or issues. Each review image is strictly associated with a single review and cannot exist independently. Images are managed exclusively through their parent review and are not directly accessible via independent API endpoints.

This subsidiary model supports rich content expression in reviews without compromising the normalization of the primary review entity. Images may be moderated or removed if they violate content policies.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_id
foreignFields.description: The review this image belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: The secure URL pointing to the stored image file. All images are uploaded to a content delivery network with permanent URLs.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the image was uploaded to accompany the review.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_reactions
models.description:
User reactions (upvotes/downvotes) to product reviews.

Tracks how other users interact with reviews by providing simple feedback mechanisms (like/dislike). These reactions help surface the most helpful reviews and support moderation decisions. Reactions are supporting data that have no independent existence outside their associated review and are managed exclusively through review workflows.

This subsidiary model enables community-driven quality assessment of reviews without requiring complex comment threads. Reactions are counted to identify top-rated reviews and can inform moderator actions.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_id
foreignFields.description: The review this reaction is applied to. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who submitted this reaction. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: reaction_type
plainFields.description: The type of reaction: 'upvote' or 'downvote'. Indicates whether the reaction supports or contradicts the review content.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the reaction was submitted.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_moderation_logs
models.description:
Historical audit trail of all moderation actions taken on reviews.

Records every change to a review's moderation status, along with the admin who made the change, the reason for the action, and the exact timestamp. This snapshot table preserves the complete history of moderation decisions to ensure transparency, enable accountability, and support compliance audits.

Each entry represents a point-in-time state of a review's moderation status and cannot be modified. This is a strictly append-only table that supports forensic analysis of moderation workflows and provides a reliable audit trail for all review moderation decisions.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_id
foreignFields.description: The review that was moderated. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: The admin who performed the moderation action. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: previous_status
plainFields.description: The moderation status of the review before this change. Values: 'pending', 'published', 'rejected', 'hidden', or null.

plainFields.name: new_status
plainFields.description: The moderation status of the review after this change. Values: 'pending', 'published', 'rejected', 'hidden'.

plainFields.name: action_reason
plainFields.description: The explanation provided by the moderator for this action. Often includes policy violation codes or specific feedback for the reviewer.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The exact timestamp when this moderation action was performed.

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_units
models.description:
Core inventory units tracking available stock for each product variant.

Represents the current available quantity of each product variant in the warehouse. This is the authoritative source for stock availability during checkout.

Each record corresponds to one unique product variant. The quantity field reflects the actual available stock after all reservations and allocations have been accounted for.

This table is the primary source for inventory availability checks during order processing and should be accessed using atomic operations to prevent race conditions.

Maintains the canonical stock count that is updated by inventory_transactions.

@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id

foreignFields.name: product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product variant this inventory unit tracks. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who owns this inventory. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Current available stock quantity for this product variant. Must be >= 0.

plainFields.name: min_stock_threshold
plainFields.description: Minimum stock level that triggers an alert. When stock falls below this threshold, inventory_alerts are created.

plainFields.name: last_updated
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last inventory update. Used for cache invalidation and sync processes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this inventory record was first created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this inventory record was last modified.

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_reservations
models.description:
Temporary reservations of inventory units for pending orders.

Represents quantities of products that have been reserved for pending orders but not yet confirmed as purchased. This table prevents overselling by locking inventory during the checkout process.

Each reservation has a finite lifetime (typically 15 minutes) and is automatically released if the payment doesn't complete. Reservations are released when the order is canceled or after timeout.

This table links to order_items to track which specific order is responsible for the reservation.

@link shopping_mall_order_items.id

foreignFields.name: inventory_unit_id
foreignFields.description: The inventory unit this reservation applies to. {@link shopping_mall_inventory_units.id}.

foreignFields.name: order_item_id
foreignFields.description: The order item that created this reservation. {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of items reserved. Must be > 0.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: When this reservation will automatically expire if not converted to a purchase. After this time, the reservation is canceled and inventory is released.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this reservation was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this reservation was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_transactions

foreignFields.name: inventory_unit_id
foreignFields.description: The inventory unit this transaction affected. {@link shopping_mall_inventory_units.id}.

foreignFields.name: source_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: The order item that triggered this transaction (if applicable). {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

foreignFields.name: source_return_id
foreignFields.description: The return that triggered this transaction (if applicable). {@link shopping_mall_order_returns.id}.

foreignFields.name: source_adjustment_id
foreignFields.description: The manual adjustment record that caused this transaction (if applicable).

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller associated with this transaction. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Type of transaction. Valid values: 'reserved', 'allocated', 'released', 'returned', 'adjusted'.

plainFields.name: quantity_change
plainFields.description: Change in quantity. Positive for increases (returns, adjustments), negative for decreases (reservations, allocations).

plainFields.name: quantity_after
plainFields.description: Quantity of inventory after this transaction was applied. Used for audit replay and reconciliation.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Additional context about this transaction (e.g., reason for adjustment, source system). Max 500 characters.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this transaction was recorded in the system. This is immutable.

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_alerts

foreignFields.name: inventory_unit_id
foreignFields.description: The inventory unit that generated this alert. {@link shopping_mall_inventory_units.id}.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller owner of the inventory unit that triggered the alert. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: alert_type
plainFields.description: Type of alert. Valid values: 'low_stock', 'critical_stock', 'back_in_stock'.

plainFields.name: threshold
plainFields.description: Stock threshold that triggered this alert.

plainFields.name: current_stock
plainFields.description: Current stock quantity when this alert was triggered.

plainFields.name: alerted_at
plainFields.description: When this alert was generated.

plainFields.name: cleared_at
plainFields.description: When this alert was cleared (if cleared). Null if still active.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the alert: 'active' or 'cleared'.

models.name: shopping_mall_coupons
models.description:
Coupon codes issued for promotional discounts to customers.

Contains unique discount codes that customers can redeem during checkout. Each coupon has specific terms including discount amount, expiration date, usage limits, and eligibility criteria.

Coupons are created by admins or automated systems and distributed to customers through marketing channels. They can be single-use or reusable, with restrictions on minimum purchase amounts and product categories.

The coupon status indicates whether it's active, expired, or redeemed beyond its limit. Coupon value can be fixed amount or percentage off.

foreignFields.name: created_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who created this coupon. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: campaign_id
foreignFields.description: Promotional campaign that issued this coupon. {@link shopping_mall_promotional_campaigns.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique alphanumeric coupon code that customers enter at checkout. Must be URL-safe and case-insensitive.

plainFields.name: discount_amount
plainFields.description: Fixed monetary discount amount in USD. Either this field or discount_percentage must be set, but not both.

plainFields.name: discount_percentage
plainFields.description: Percentage discount applied to order total. Either this field or discount_amount must be set, but not both. Must be between 0.1 and 100.

plainFields.name: min_order_value
plainFields.description: Minimum order value required to use this coupon. Must be greater than 0. If null, no minimum applies.

plainFields.name: max_usage_count
plainFields.description: Maximum number of times this coupon can be redeemed across all customers. Must be greater than 0.

plainFields.name: usage_count
plainFields.description: Current number of times this coupon has been successfully redeemed. Must be less than or equal to max_usage_count.

plainFields.name: valid_from
plainFields.description: Date and time when the coupon becomes valid for redemption. Customers cannot use it before this time.

plainFields.name: valid_until
plainFields.description: Date and time when the coupon expires and can no longer be redeemed.

plainFields.name: applicable_to_categories
plainFields.description: JSON array of category IDs that this coupon can be applied to. If null, coupon applies to all categories.

plainFields.name: applicable_to_products
plainFields.description: JSON array of product IDs that this coupon can be applied to. If null, coupon applies to all products.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the coupon. Valid values: 'active', 'expired', 'limited_exceeded'. Indicates whether the coupon can be redeemed and why it might be inactive.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this coupon record was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this coupon record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this coupon was logically deleted (soft delete). Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_coupon_redemptions
models.description:
Records of individual coupon redemptions by customers during checkout.

Each redemption is an audit trail of when and how a specific coupon code was used to discount a specific order. This table captures redemption events with full context including user, order, and timestamp.

Redemption records are immutable once created and represent a single successful application of a coupon to a single order. This table enables tracking of redemption patterns, abuse detection, and financial reconciliation.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who redeemed this coupon. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: coupon_id
foreignFields.description: Coupon that was redeemed in this transaction. {@link shopping_mall_coupons.id}.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: Order to which this coupon redemption was applied. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: discount_amount
plainFields.description: Actual monetary discount amount applied to this specific order. This may be less than the coupon's stated discount if constrained by order value.

plainFields.name: discount_type
plainFields.description: Type of discount applied: 'fixed_amount' or 'percentage'. Mirrors the coupon's discount structure at redemption time.

plainFields.name: applied_at
plainFields.description: Exact timestamp when this coupon was successfully applied during checkout.

plainFields.name: is_valid
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the coupon redemption was valid at the time of application. False if coupon was expired or invalidated after redemption but before order confirmation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this redemption record was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this redemption record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this redemption record was logically deleted (soft delete). Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_promotional_campaigns
models.description:
Marketing campaigns that generate multiple coupons or offer special promotions.

Represents promotional marketing initiatives with defined start/end dates, target audience criteria, budget constraints, and performance goals. Each campaign can generate multiple coupons and has overall usage limits.

Campaigns are created by marketing teams and are the organizational unit for managing multiple related promotions. This table defines the business context and objectives behind coupon distributions.

foreignFields.name: created_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who created this promotional campaign. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the promotional campaign used for internal tracking and reporting.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the campaign goals, target audience, and promotional terms.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Date and time when the campaign becomes active and coupons can begin being issued.

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: Date and time when the campaign ends and no new coupons can be generated.

plainFields.name: total_budget
plainFields.description: Total monetary budget allocated for this campaign. This represents the maximum total discount amount that can be redeemed across all coupons from this campaign.

plainFields.name: used_budget
plainFields.description: Total amount of discount already redeemed from coupons generated by this campaign.

plainFields.name: target_customer_segment
plainFields.description: JSON object defining customer targeting criteria (e.g., new customers only, customers with purchase history > $100). Null means no segmentation.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the campaign. Valid values: 'draft', 'active', 'paused', 'completed', 'expired'. Controls whether new coupons can be generated.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this campaign record was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this campaign record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this campaign was logically deleted (soft delete). Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_loyalty_points
models.description:
Accumulated loyalty points balance per customer for rewards.

Tracks the current balance of loyalty points for each customer based on their purchase history and promotional activities. This is a running balance that increases with purchases and decreases when redeemed.

Points are the currency in the loyalty program and can be redeemed for discounts or rewards during checkout. The balance is updated based on point transactions and represents the customer's current redeemable value.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this loyalty balance. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: balance
plainFields.description: Current number of loyalty points available for redemption by this customer. Points are non-transferable and non-refundable.

plainFields.name: points_multiplier
plainFields.description: Multiplier that determines how much points are earned per dollar spent (e.g., 1.0 means $1 = 1 point, 2.5 means $1 = 2.5 points).

plainFields.name: expiry_policy
plainFields.description: Policy defining how loyalty points expire. Valid values: 'no_expiry', '12_months', '24_months', '36_months'.

plainFields.name: last_updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to this balance, indicating when the last point transaction occurred.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this loyalty balance record was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this loyalty balance record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this loyalty balance record was logically deleted (soft delete). Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_loyalty_point_transactions
models.description:
Audit trail of individual points earned or redeemed by customers.

Each transaction represents a discrete event that changes a customer's loyalty points balance, including rewards for purchases, bonus points, or point redemptions.

This table provides complete traceability for every change to loyalty balances, enabling reconciliation, fraud detection, and customer service inquiries. Each transaction records the source, amount, and context of the points change.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who earned or redeemed these points. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: Order that generated this point transaction (for purchase rewards). {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: promotion_id
foreignFields.description: Promotional campaign that granted this bonus point award. {@link shopping_mall_promotional_campaigns.id}.

plainFields.name: points
plainFields.description: Change in loyalty points (+ for earned, - for redeemed). Must be non-zero.

plainFields.name: transaction_type
plainFields.description: Type of transaction: 'purchase_reward', 'sign_up_bonus', 'referral_bonus', 'point_redemption', 'admin_adjustment'.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the transaction: 'pending', 'completed', 'reversed'. Indicates whether points have been applied to balance.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable description of the transaction for customer notifications and audit purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this transaction record was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this transaction record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this transaction record was logically deleted (soft delete). Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_notification_templates
models.description:
System-defined notification templates for automatic message generation.

Contains pre-approved message templates used across the platform to ensure consistent communication style and compliance. Templates are referenced by notification system during message generation and are configured at the system level by admins. Each template is versioned and activated/deactivated as needed to support global communication changes without code deployment.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Human-readable title for the template, used in admin interfaces for identification.

plainFields.name: subject
plainFields.description: Email subject line template. May include placeholders like {customer_name} or {order_id}.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Main content body of the notification template. Supports templating variables for dynamic content insertion. Used for both email and in-app notifications.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Category of notification. Defines the context for when this template is triggered. Example values: order_confirmed, payment_failed, seller_approved, review_published.

plainFields.name: language
plainFields.description: Language of the template content (e.g., 'en', 'ko', 'es'). Supports multilingual notification delivery.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this template is currently active and available for use in notifications. Inactive templates are archived but preserved for audit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this template was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this template was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Indicates when the template was marked for archival. Null means not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_notification_queue
models.description:
Transient queue for pending notifications awaiting delivery.

Holds notifications in a processing queue before they are dispatched. Items in this table are consumed by background workers that handle delivery via email, in-app, or push notification services. Each record represents a single notification attempt and may be retried upon failure. Queue entries are temporary and cleared upon successful delivery.

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: Target actor for this notification. References the actor who receives this message. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}, {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}, or {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: template_id
foreignFields.description: Template used to generate this notification. {@link shopping_mall_notification_templates.id}.

plainFields.name: recipient_email
plainFields.description: Email address of the recipient. Retrieved from actor table at time of queue entry. Used as fallback if direct email service fails.

plainFields.name: notification_type
plainFields.description: Type of notification being queued. Must match the template's type. Used for routing and filtering.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Delivery priority level: 1 (high), 2 (normal), 3 (low). High priority messages are processed first.

plainFields.name: attempt_count
plainFields.description: Number of times this notification has been attempted for delivery. Incremented on each failure.

plainFields.name: max_attempts
plainFields.description: Maximum number of delivery attempts allowed before the notification is abandoned. Typically 3-5.

plainFields.name: scheduled_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this notification should be processed. Allows for delayed delivery (e.g., 24 hours after event).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this queue entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this queue entry was last updated (e.g., attempt count incremented).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Used to mark entries as consumed or abandoned after max attempts reached.

models.name: shopping_mall_notification_deliveries
models.description:
Audit trail of notification delivery attempts and outcomes.

Records every delivery event for compliance, debugging, and analytics. Each record corresponds to one delivery attempt and captures whether it succeeded, failed, or was skipped. Immutable history of communication to users. Never updated after creation - new records are appended on retries.

foreignFields.name: queue_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the queue entry that triggered this delivery attempt. {@link shopping_mall_notification_queue.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: Actor who received this notification. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}, {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}, or {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: template_id
foreignFields.description: Template used for this delivery attempt. {@link shopping_mall_notification_templates.id}.

plainFields.name: delivery_channel
plainFields.description: Channel used for delivery: 'email', 'in_app', or 'push'.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Outcome of this delivery attempt. Values: 'success', 'failed', 'skipped'.

plainFields.name: gateway_response
plainFields.description: Raw response received from the delivery service (e.g., SMTP server, push notification provider). Used for debugging failures.

plainFields.name: error_code
plainFields.description: Standardized error code if delivery failed (e.g., 'INVALID_EMAIL', 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE', 'RATE_LIMITED').

plainFields.name: delivered_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when delivery was successfully completed. Null if delivery failed or was skipped.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this delivery record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this delivery record was last updated (e.g., status changed).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Historical records are retained permanently and this field is rarely used.

models.name: shopping_mall_notification_preferences
models.description:
User-configurable notification preferences per actor and notification type.

Allows customers, sellers, and admins to opt-in or opt-out of specific notification types. These preferences are consulted by the system before queuing any notification. Preferences are stored per actor and per notification category to provide fine-grained control while preserving default system behavior for unconfigured users.

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: Actor who owns these preferences. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}, {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}, or {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: notification_type
plainFields.description: The notification type this preference applies to (e.g., order_confirmed, payment_failed, seller_approved). Must match template types.

plainFields.name: email_enabled
plainFields.description: Whether to send this notification type via email. True by default for most critical notifications.

plainFields.name: in_app_enabled
plainFields.description: Whether to show this notification type as an in-app message. True for most user-facing alerts.

plainFields.name: push_enabled
