plainFields.description: Whether to send this notification via push notifications (mobile app). Null means inherit system default; true/false overrides default.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this preference was first set or last modified.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this preference was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Indicates when preference was archived. Null if active and not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_audit_logs
models.description:
System audit logs recording critical security and compliance events including authentication attempts, system configuration changes, and administrative actions. These logs are essential for forensic analysis, regulatory compliance, and identifying potential security breaches. All entries are append-only and immutable once created.

Records every significant system event including login attempts, account modifications, permission changes, and system flag activations. Links to the actor (customer, seller, or admin) who triggered the event and captures metadata about the action context.

This is a primary audit trail that supports legal compliance requirements, internal security review, and incident investigation. Every access to sensitive systems or data manipulation is captured here.

The data here is used for SOC 2, GDPR, and other regulatory reporting requirements. Cannot be modified or deleted once recorded.

@link shopping_mall_customers.id, @link shopping_mall_sellers.id, @link shopping_mall_admins.id

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: The actor who performed the action. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}, {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}, or {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor who performed the action: 'customer', 'seller', or 'admin'. Used for polymorphic relationship resolution.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Category of the audit event (e.g., 'login', 'logout', 'password_change', 'seller_approval', 'product_update', 'data_deletion').

plainFields.name: event_details
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the event including coordinates, user agent, IP address, and specific action performed.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Success/failure status of the event: 'success', 'failed', 'denied'.

plainFields.name: source
plainFields.description: Origin of the event: 'web', 'mobile', 'api', 'admin_dashboard'.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address from which the action was performed.

plainFields.name: location
plainFields.description: Geographic location derived from IP address, if available.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: HTTP User-Agent string identifying the client device and browser.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was created. Always set by system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was last updated. Always set by system.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the log entry was logically deleted. For compliance, should remain null in production environments.

models.name: shopping_mall_access_logs
models.description:
Access logs recording all authentication and system access events related to user sessions. These logs establish a security trail showing who accessed the system, when, and from where - critical for compliance and security investigations.

Tracks each login attempt, successful session initiation, and logout event. Associates each event with a specific actor (customer, seller, or admin) and their authentication details.

This foundational log enables detection of unauthorized access patterns, brute force attacks, and compromised accounts. Essential for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and financial compliance standards.

All entries are append-only and immutable. Never modified or deleted once recorded.

@link shopping_mall_customers.id, @link shopping_mall_sellers.id, @link shopping_mall_admins.id

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: The actor who initiated the session. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}, {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}, or {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor who initiated access: 'customer', 'seller', or 'admin'.

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Type of access action: 'login', 'logout', 'session_refresh', 'token_regeneration'.

plainFields.name: application
plainFields.description: Application or service where access occurred: 'web_portal', 'mobile_app', 'admin_dashboard'.

plainFields.name: session_id
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the user session. Correlates with active sessions table.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address from which the access was initiated.

plainFields.name: location
plainFields.description: Geographic location derived from IP address, if available.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: HTTP User-Agent string identifying the client device and browser.

plainFields.name: device_type
plainFields.description: Classification of device: 'desktop', 'mobile', 'tablet', 'unknown'.

plainFields.name: is_first_login
plainFields.description: Indicates if this was the user's first successful login after registration

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the access log entry was created. Always set by system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the access log entry was last updated. Always set by system.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the log entry was logically deleted. For compliance, should remain null in production environments.

models.name: shopping_mall_data_change_logs
models.description:
Data change logs tracking all modifications to business-critical data entities including order updates, product edits, customer profile changes, and inventory adjustments. These logs provide a complete audit trail for data integrity and regulatory compliance.

Record every create, update, and delete operation on entities like products, orders, customers, sellers, and inventory. Capture both the state before and after modification to establish historical accuracy.

This table serves as the comprehensive regulator of data truth - essential for forensic investigations, customer disputes, and compliance reporting under GDPR, CCPA, and BI guidelines.

All changes are immutable. Deleted fields are retained as historical records - never physically erased.

@link shopping_mall_customers.id, @link shopping_mall_sellers.id, @link shopping_mall_admins.id, @link shopping_mall_products.id, @link shopping_mall_orders.id, @link shopping_mall_inventory_units.id

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: The actor who made the data change. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}, {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}, or {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: entity_id
foreignFields.description: The ID of the entity being modified - references any business object: product, order, customer, etc. Must be linked to the entity_type.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor who made the change: 'customer', 'seller', or 'admin'.

plainFields.name: entity_type
plainFields.description: Type of entity being modified: 'product', 'order', 'customer', 'seller', 'inventory', 'review', 'coupon', 'notification', etc.

plainFields.name: change_type
plainFields.description: Type of data change: 'create', 'update', 'delete'.

plainFields.name: field_name
plainFields.description: Specific field that was modified (e.g., 'price', 'status', 'email').

plainFields.name: old_value
plainFields.description: Previous value before the change, stored as JSON for complex types.

plainFields.name: new_value
plainFields.description: New value after the change, stored as JSON for complex types.

plainFields.name: change_reason
plainFields.description: Context or reason for the change (e.g., 'customer modified profile', 'admin approved seller').

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address from which the change was made.

plainFields.name: location
plainFields.description: Geographic location derived from IP address, if available.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: HTTP User-Agent string identifying the client device and browser.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the data change event was recorded. Always set by system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the data change log was last updated. Always set by system.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the log entry was logically deleted. For compliance, should remain null in production environments.
